runtime.batchStatus: topic.batch-status updates enabled status for a bounded ids array
runtime.batchStatusUi: ability page renders topic.batch-status as bounded summary and per-id result table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.adminLinkFilters: topic content relation list supports optional topicId/contentId filters with bound SQL and maxAdminLinkRows limit
runtime.arrangeUi: ability page loads topic content rows and provides Up/Down ordering before bounded sort save
runtime.sortResultUi: ability page renders topic.content.sort as submitted/updated/bounded summary table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.adminStats: topic.stats returns bounded read-only aggregate status and top topic relation counts
runtime.adminStatsUi: ability page renders topic.stats as summary, status and top relation tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.requestLimit: admin topic write endpoints reject request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
runtime.statusValidation: topic.save normalizes status to enabled(1) or disabled(0)
runtime.categoryBindIntegration: topic.contents result rows prefer content_category_bind when content.category is enabled
runtime.accessIntegration: topic.contents filters restricted content when content.access is enabled; topic.list/detail hide aggregate content counts when access is mounted
